Capstone 6.0.0-Alpha5 (capstone-engine/capstone, commit fad9f80564501f083adc92db3ef37f999af28dd0),
the version Tracy 0.13.1's own build pins. Used only by the in-game Tracy Worker
(../tracy-ingame), to disassemble the code a capture transfers.

Kept: the engine sources and headers, include/, LICENSES/, arch/X86 (Intel syntax; the AT&T printer
and the _reduce tables are left out, matching Tracy's CAPSTONE_X86_ATT_DISABLE build), arch/AArch64,
and every other arch's *Module.h, which cs.c includes unconditionally. Built by the TracyClient block
in ../CMakeLists.txt.
